nodes.label: Java 21 Requirement
nodes.rationale: Project fails to compile with Java 25 due to Lombok compatibility issues. Java 21 is required.

nodes.label: Zero Entity Exposure
nodes.rationale: REST API must never return JPA Entities directly. Always map Entity to ResponseDTO to avoid exposing internal structure, preventing N+1 query issues, and decoupling API from database schema.

nodes.label: 2GB RAM VPS Optimization
nodes.rationale: 2GB RAM is tight for Java + Postgres + Node.js. Swap file is mandatory. JVM heap limited to 512m with -Xms256m -Xmx512m and UseSerialGC to fit alongside Postgres (300m) and Nuxt (300m).

nodes.label: Dedicated DTO Layer
nodes.rationale: Backend strictly uses DTOs for all Controller interactions, never exposing Entities directly. This is a key design decision to decouple the API contract from the persistence model.
